low.description: All critical criteria met, no red flags

medium.description: Most critical criteria met, some gaps or concerns
medium.action: Proceed with additional scrutiny; request missing evidence

high.description: Critical criteria not met or significant red flags
high.action: Escalate for human review; do not proceed without resolution

blocked.description: Vendor is sanctioned or otherwise prohibited
blocked.action: Do not proceed. Report to compliance.

evidence_quality.high: Official documentation, verified certifications, audited records
evidence_quality.medium: Vendor self-reported data, dated but plausible claims
evidence_quality.low: Unattributed claims, marketing language, stale data

source_validation.complete: All claims verified against cited sources
source_validation.partially_complete: Most claims verified; some gaps noted
